name: ryu.tavily
description: Search-and-extract for agents via the Tavily API (https://tavily.com), exposed as two declarative HTTP tools. Provides the swappable `web.search` and `web.extract` layers, so selecting it in the layer picker re-points the stable `web.search` / `web.extract` tools at Tavily without changing what agents call. Requires a BYOK Tavily API key.
